_about: Hand-kept cases for scripts/gold-checks.ts, on top of the ones it derives from staff's ratings in page_reviews. `expect` lists flags the check must raise on the page as it is now (key, optional problem, optional `about` regex over reason+fix); `reject` lists flags it must not raise. Add a case whenever a gap is found by hand, with the date and what it taught.

cases.lesson: The May 2, 2016 minutes say 'give Bylaw No. 1628 First Reading' under an (ADOPTION) heading; the signed bylaw says adopted that day. While the page says the plan only got a first reading or that adoption is not shown, the check must flag the May 2 entry from the signed bylaw. Retire this case once the page says adopted May 2, 2016.
